title: Queen Victoria to Big Bird in four real photos
description: Four real photos connect Queen Victoria to Big Bird from Sesame Street, through a king who gave up his throne, a president and a first lady.
hook: How is Queen Victoria connected to Big Bird?

links.line: In 1895 at Balmoral, Queen Victoria posed with her baby great-grandson, the future King Edward the Eighth.

image.file: File:President Nixon greets the Duke and Duchess of Windsor - NARA - 194310.tif

links.line: In 1970, Edward, who gave up the throne to become Duke of Windsor, dined at Richard Nixon's White House.

image.file: File:President Richard Nixon and First Lady Pat Nixon.jpg

links.line: From 1969 to 1974, Pat Nixon served beside him as first lady.
And in December 1970, Big Bird visited Pat Nixon at the White House with a Christmas gift feather.
